summary: Turn bounded redacted AXM task receipts into replayable lesson candidates and anti-drift profiles, then measure reviewed held-out use through receipt-bound paired evidence without averaging dissent.
notes: EXPERIMENTAL. The module cannot enumerate Codex tasks by itself, authenticate a host or reviewer by itself, read raw histories, message tasks, enroll recipients, rewrite prompts, invent outcomes or scores, train model weights, merge, promote, inherit, or canonize. A shadow clone pickup is an ephemeral evidence profile, not a person or autonomous identity.
